### 🚀 v0.15.0

#### New Features

- **Dashboards** — Added dashboards combining views from multiple databases, with movable and resizable widgets, shared filters, and personal filter changes. Local dashboards could reuse existing views; creating new widget views required a server connection.
- **Charts and drill-downs** — Added Number charts for workspaces with Pro features, expanded grouping and display controls, and drill-down tables for exploring a chart's records and saving the result as a filtered view.
- **Page widths** — Added full-width and custom-width formatting per document, shared with collaborators while retaining each user's default for pages without an explicit width.
- **Image search results** — Showed the image and matched text behind a search result, and opened documents at the matched image when the server supplied this information.
- **Native update installation** — Added user-initiated installation on macOS and Windows x64 when the server enabled it and supplied a signed update feed. Retained manual downloads when native installation was unavailable.

#### Improvements

- **Database exports** — Added A4, A3, Letter, and Legal paper sizes with portrait or landscape orientation. Paginated wide PDF tables at a readable size and exported the active view's visible fields and current rows, with support for complete offline caches.
- **Board views** — Added sorting within columns, column calculations, and backgrounds based on group colors.
- **Images** — Saved thumbnails and decoded images at their display size across documents and database cards, reducing the size of images held in memory.
- **Translations** — Updated interface translations and corrected Grid header and cell alignment in right-to-left languages.

#### Bug Fixes

- Preserved individual heading text during multi-block conversion, kept link formatting when editing URLs, and allowed read-only toggle blocks to expand without changing the shared document.
- Prevented moving subpages in the sidebar from sending them to Trash, and preserved external-link and date mentions when copying or exporting document text.
- Corrected row peek navigation and calendar row opening, focused newly added Grid rows for editing, and kept hidden Board groups usable during partial schema refreshes.
- Preserved document image sizes while scrolling and recovered missing or damaged media caches without losing image authentication.
- Prevented duplicated database content from uploading before its page was acknowledged by the server, and preserved database layouts when reopening views.
- Fixed PDF image reading with Ollama models that advertised vision support through their capabilities.

#### ⚠️ Action Required

- Self-hosted workspaces still require **AppFlowy Cloud v0.19.10 or later**.
- Self-hosted dashboards require server support for the Dashboard layout. Before using more than twelve widgets or four widgets in one row, deploy the updated dashboard validation to every realtime server.

name: v0.14.11

### 🚀 v0.14.11

#### New Features

- **Relative-date comparisons** — Added Today, Yesterday, and Tomorrow to date comparisons such as before, after, on or before, and on or after, so filters followed the calendar without selecting a new date each day.
- **YouTube captions** — Added direct import of available timestamped captions into AI transcript blocks without downloading audio or using transcription minutes. Retained audio transcription and file upload as alternatives when captions were unavailable.
- **Missing row pages** — Added a "Create empty page" action when a supporting server reported an unavailable row document, with a warning and explicit confirmation. Kept readable and locally cached content ahead of recreation.

#### Improvements

- **Gallery views** — Added grouped card layouts, configurable previews and card sizes, image fitting, and cover repositioning.
- **Feed views** — Refreshed card previews, quick actions, reactions, and comment discussions, with a full-page action for longer content.
- **Plans and connections** — Routed hosted upgrade prompts through the Plan settings, kept Cloud billing unavailable in local and self-hosted sessions, and added clearer connection-loading errors with retry actions.

#### Bug Fixes

- Fixed linking databases with incomplete sync data, refreshing embedded database tabs after sync, and loading repaired rows after an explicit retry.
- Made formula properties easier to find in filter and sort pickers, paused incompatible filters when formula result types changed, and corrected rollups that read other rollups.
- Preserved center peek when navigating between rows and prevented canceled row-page opens from leaving later opens stuck.
- Corrected page-reference states for trashed, missing, and temporarily unavailable pages, and stopped slow permission lookups from holding up the Share menu's people list.
- Kept reconnect feedback visible until the connection was confirmed, with another retry available if it did not connect.

#### ⚠️ Action Required

- Self-hosted workspaces still require **AppFlowy Cloud v0.19.10 or later**. Before enabling missing-row-page recovery, deploy its server support to every node handling live edits.

name: v0.14.10

### 🚀 v0.14.10

#### New Features

- **Database side peek** — Added a resizable panel for editing row pages beside their database. Added navigation through visible rows and switching between side peek, center peek, full page, and a new tab while preserving edits.

#### Improvements

- **Charts and lists** — Refreshed chart settings, labels, and tooltips, and corrected calculations using currency and percentage values. Adapted list rows to narrow windows, with properties below the title when space is limited.
- **Database loading** — Opened cached views and row pages without waiting for server refreshes, and loaded initial board cards without fetching every row. Improved recovery from interrupted downloads and displayed available rows while missing rows recovered. Local databases completed loading without remote requests.
- **Cloud creation** — Saved new pages and database rows on the server before exposing them for editing, with loading feedback and recovery for interrupted creation requests.
- **Updates and errors** — Unified desktop update prompts with release notes, download links, and server compatibility guidance. Replaced technical error text with clearer localized messages and guidance when an action's outcome was uncertain.
- **Date formulas** — Avoided unnecessary recalculation of `today()` formulas while retaining refreshes when the date or time zone changed.

#### Bug Fixes

- Fixed row edits and access restrictions across peek navigation, and restored Escape dismissal after editing.
- Fixed relation-picker searches by database name and restored icon and image-upload choices on row pages and templates.
- Fixed opening supported local attachments, fullscreen video playback, and YouTube audio downloads while preserving the video's default audio track.
- Fixed workspace selection after deleting the active workspace and allowed failed space-creation dialogs to close without a server connection.

#### ⚠️ Action Required

- Self-hosted workspaces require **AppFlowy Cloud v0.19.10 or later**. Upgrade the server before upgrading to desktop v0.14.10.

- **PDF and Word imports** — Added PDF and DOCX imports into editable pages in server-backed workspaces, with batch progress, cancellation, and warnings for unsupported content.
- **Formulas and rollups** — Added formulas that read properties from related rows, rollups of formula results, and counts or percentages matching multiple selected options.

body: # This release includes a major upgrade to AppFlowy’s editor experience ## UX Update - New Features - Support ‘/’ commands to insert content types into a page - Highlight text to trigger the editing menu - Support basic Markdown syntax - Support more shortcuts ## Tech Update - New Editor - Say Hello to appflowy_editor, a highly customizable rich-text editor for Flutter, built by AppFlowy’s Team from the ground up. - This library was merged in v0.0.6 and will serve as the foundation for future improvements to AppFlowy’s editing experience. - It is highly customizable, test-covered, and well-maintained. - The goals with appflowy_editor are to make the core experience intuitive and enjoyable for all users and the building experience seamlessly for developers. - As an open-source project, appflowy_editor has the potential to realize these goals with the help of the AppFlowy Community.

## New Features - Kanban Board like Notion and Trello _beta_
Boards are the best way to manage projects & tasks. Use them to group your databases by select, multiselect, and checkbox.
- Set up columns that represent a specific phase of the project cycle and use cards to represent each project / task
- Drag and drop a card from one phase / column to another phase / column
- Update database properties in the Board view by clicking on a property and making edits on the card

## Other Features & Improvements
- Settings allow users to change avatars
- Click and drag the right edge to resize your sidebar
